chart.name: Incoming vs successful requests
chart.programText:
A = data('SuccessfulRequests', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true'), rollup='sum').sum().publish(label='A')
B = data('IncomingRequests', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true'), rollup='sum').sum().publish(label='B')

chart.programText:
A = data('IncomingBytes', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true'), rollup='average').mean(by=['azure_resource_id', 'azure_resource_name']).sum().publish(label='A')
B = data('OutgoingBytes', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true'), rollup='average').mean(by=['azure_resource_id', 'azure_resource_name']).sum().publish(label='B')
